description: Source code for SATA driver and hardware initialization routines for Oxford Semiconductor Ltd hardware, including DMA setup, SATA PHY reset, and register access functions.

methods.name: ide_preinit
methods.description: Initializes SATA hardware, resets blocks, applies workarounds, detects disks, and clears errors.

methods.name: ide_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from SATA register ports for a specific device.

methods.name: ide_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to SATA register ports for a specific device, handling command sequences.

methods.name: ide_input_data
methods.description: Receives data from SATA device into buffer using DMA, with workaround for bug-6320.

methods.name: ide_output_data
methods.description: Sends data to SATA device from buffer using DMA.

methods.name: scr_read
methods.description: Reads a SATA link register asynchronously.

methods.name: scr_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a SATA link register asynchronously.

methods.name: workaround5458
methods.description: Applies hardware workaround for PHY issues via ASIC register access.
